blocks.text: The module documentation defines the walking-skeleton sequence, quota and metering behavior, cancellation, resume restart, failure handling, and content-safe logging rules.
blocks.title: Turn lifecycle

blocks.anchor: # Fixed texts (error.json / notice: server-authored, no content, no exception text).
blocks.text: build_chain selects the first provider environment key and optional model override. Adapter installation and lazy construction keep tests injectable.
blocks.title: Adapter selection

blocks.text: Per-run locks serialize turns, _to_messages maps user and assistant history, _close_stream drains adapter cleanup under cancellation, and _emit forwards events.
blocks.title: Conversation and stream helpers

blocks.anchor: async def run_turn(conn, run, msg) -> None:
blocks.text: run_turn serializes the run and _turn checks quota, appends the user message, streams TextDelta events, emits text_done, meters usage, emits usage, and stores the assistant reply.
blocks.title: Completed turn path

blocks.text: Quota checks fail open on ledger errors but pause the run when exhausted. Provider failures pause with a fixed error, and pause state events unbind the emitter.
blocks.title: Pause failures

blocks.text: _meter prices the completed call, attempts one ledger commit, updates the informational run counter, and returns a sanitized usage event even when writes fail.
blocks.title: Usage accounting

blocks.text: Cancel and disconnect hooks stop tracked restart tasks. Resume checks whether the conversation ends in an unanswered user message, then schedules a notice and rerun under the same per-run lock.
blocks.title: Resume restart hooks

blocks.text: Installation raises the SDK logger floor and registers the turn runner plus cancel, resume, and disconnect hooks with run_handlers.
blocks.title: Installation

gotchas: Cancelled turns do not commit usage unless the model call already completed.
The restart path does not append the user message a second time.
outputs: text_delta, text_done, usage, notice, and state events
purpose: This walking-skeleton runner connects validated user messages to the model adapter and event emitter without offering tools. It appends conversation text, handles provider and quota pauses, meters completed calls, and restarts interrupted replies after resume while serializing turns per run.
summary: Runs the text-only code-agent turn, including quota checks, model streaming, usage metering, and resume restart hooks.

symbols.summary: Selects the first configured model provider and returns its provider/model/key-name descriptor.
Returns the cached adapter or builds one from the configured provider chain.
Returns or creates the weakly retained asyncio lock for one run.
Converts user and assistant conversation text into model messages with the fixed system prompt.
Closes an adapter async generator and preserves cancellation while waiting for cleanup.
Serializes and starts one validated user-message turn for a run.

symbols.summary: Performs quota check, conversation update, model streaming, event emission, and completed-turn persistence.
Checks the user's usage quota and fails open if the ledger check errors.
Pauses a run for exhausted quota, tells the device, and emits the pause state.
Pauses a run and reports a fixed provider-unavailable error after model failure.
Emits a pause state change and unbinds emitter state even when emission fails.
Prices completed usage, commits the ledger row, updates run credits, and builds the usage event.
Removes a tracked restart task only when it is the current task for the run.
Cancels and waits for a run's tracked restarted turn.
Schedules a restarted turn when a resumed conversation ends with an unanswered user message.
Emits a fixed restart notice and reruns the turn without appending the user message again.
Raises the OpenAI SDK logger floor so prompts are not emitted at debug level.
Registers the hello turn runner and its cancel, resume, and disconnect hooks.
